race.description: Thank You Chris Barrett Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ALBERT PALAIS (1) has been thereabouts in all four starts in his first campaign and finds a winnable contest despite drawing out. Posted wide up on the speed and never surrendered with a game fifth over 1400m in a Super Maiden at Warwick Farm. Will push forward and figure prominently. HOZUMI (5) was slow into stride on debut and like the way he closed late at the big odds when seventh over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Should come on from that performance and stays in the calculations. CONFUCIUS (7) tracked the speed and boxed on steadily on debut before fading late when fifth over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Has claims despite drawing out. PALM TREE (12) began only fairly on debut and never got into the contest when last in a Super Mdn over 1250m at Canterbury. Expecting a better effort today.
